own_solution.law: Power is energy per unit time. Unit identities: 1 W = 1 J/s, 1 kW = 1000 W, and 1 mW = 0.001 W.
assumptions: Each meter reading is converted directly using the stated unit.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: The second rendering reports 220 W, whereas the other three report 200 W, so the variants change the physical power as well as its representation.

counterexamples: The second variant gives 0.22 kW × 1000 W/kW = 220 W, which differs from 200 W by 20 W.
notes: Answers in packet order are 200 W, 220 W, 200 W, and 200 W. Each rendering is individually well-posed; the invalid verdict concerns their inconsistency as renderings of one problem. No separate base problem or added distractor statements are supplied.
